overall_reason: A strict system: square corners with pills only, one ink colour in alpha steps, 13 font sizes all on the Tailwind scale, spacing on 4px, with an empty dark-theme scaffold and many motion durations as the only loose ends.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY, T-SCALE-FIT and T-DRIFT-PAIRS pass (one radius, font size on_token 0.98, no near-duplicate colours); muted text on the dark band uses six opacity steps and the dark block is empty (TOK-001, TOK-009).

findings.where: dark band sections and muted text; 1440 (tiles/1440-04.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.colour_text shows the light ink #fafaf8 at /0.70 (73), /0.60, /0.50, /0.40, /0.30 and /0.20, and the dark ink #080503 at /0.80 (63), /0.70 and /0.30, beside #5e534a (182) for body copy.
findings.before: Nine alpha steps of two inks for secondary text
findings.after: Two muted steps per surface (for example /0.70 and /0.40), named as roles
findings.why: Opacity picked per element turns one 'muted' job into many.

findings.evidence: theme.dark_tokens_class_or_attr is 1 and semantic_colour_redefined_share is 0.0: the shadcn .dark scaffold remains but redefines none of the 28 semantic colours.
findings.before: A dark class that does nothing
findings.after: Remove the empty .dark block, or fill it with all 28 roles
findings.why: An empty theme hook invites partial dark styling later.

strengths: One radius decision: pills only, everything else square (values.1440.radius has 1 value).
Font sizes on the Tailwind scale (on_token 0.98) with a 1.333 ratio well above chance; spacing on 4px at both widths.
Radius, colour and spacing declarations are 92% var or more.
not_investigated: Durations run in 10 values (150, 300, 400, 500, 700 and long loops); left to lens-motion.
Fonts: the sweep reports Consolas drawing text declared as Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono (font requests blocked); capture context, not judged.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (platform landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
